Project description: Creator onboarding flow: developers link a repository to Singularity, then the system runs automated static + dynamic checks to validate quality, stability, and safety. Goal: make “getting into the ecosystem” low-friction while establishing a trust baseline for every uploaded asset.

Project name: The Client Perspective (search → adapt → verify → ship)
Project description: End-user workflow that turns an idea into trusted code in four steps: (1) describe what’s needed and search by function, (2) adapt the asset to the target engine/language, (3) verify integration in the developer’s native environment, and (4) deliver a ready-to-ship code block. Focus on clarity, speed, and trust signals throughout the flow.

Project name: The Integration Engine (logic preservation + semantic mapping)
Project description: LLM-assisted adaptation layer that preserves logic while translating assets across programming languages and game engines. Includes semantic mapping + syntax adaptation to generate equivalent code (e.g., C# → Python) and prepare it for downstream integration checks. Objective: seamless cross-engine portability without breaking behavior.

Project name: How People Make Money (UID + asset tracking + smart contracting)
Project description: Monetization + attribution system that assigns a unique ID (UID) to every creator/client and permanently tags submitted code for tracking. Ensures original creators are identified and compensated when code is adapted and reused, with smart-contracting concepts to automate payouts and support a creator marketplace economy.
